description: This file is a Jinja template for generating Python code related to the backward pass of a Flash Attention operator in a PyTorch project. It includes definitions for kernel functions, conditional imports, and JIT-compiled functions for score and mask modifications, with references to external C++/CUDA components. It also sets up tensor buffers and calls a core function '_flash_attn_bwd' for the computation.

classes.name: BlockSparseTensorsTorch
classes.description: Class for handling block sparse tensor structures used in attention masks and sparse matrix operations.

methods.name: score_mod
methods.description: A JIT-compiled function for applying a score modification subgraph, conditioned on HAS_SCORE_MOD.

methods.name: score_mod_bwd
methods.description: A JIT-compiled function for applying the backward pass of the score modification, conditioned on HAS_SCORE_MOD.

methods.name: mask_mod
methods.description: A JIT-compiled function for applying a block sparsity mask subgraph, conditioned on HAS_BLOCK_MASK.
